assertion_review.normal_hot_eviction: Warm hot+anchor three times, preserve mapped anchor references, read bounded churn under memory.max=20MiB until mincore reports at most 1/8 hot pages resident. No fadvise or drop_caches. LRU pgdeactivate and pgsteal must increase.
assertion_review.refault_not_cold_read: Both kernels report positive workingset_refault and workingset_activate during the measured hot read. Cold reads report neither.
assertion_review.exclude_reclaim_false_positive: After preparation completes and worker blocks on a pipe, parent raises memory.max to128MiB and keeps memory.high=max; then arms thresholds, captures fresh PSI/reclaim baselines and starts the measured read. pgscan, pgsteal and memory.events max must remain unchanged throughout measurement.
assertion_review.real_backing_io: Read-only ext4 on a96MiB guest RAM-loop; buffered2MiB files contain nonzero allocated data, and v1 blkio read cap512KiB/s produces positive IO some/full plus strict PRI notifications.
assertion_review.memory_notification: Old kernel hot memory PSI remains zero with no event; new kernel hot PSI increases by3.476059s and emits strict PRI without ERR/HUP/NVAL.
assertion_review.cold_control: First cold file read begins with mincore resident0, ample128MiB budget, memory PSI remains0 on both kernels despite about4s of IO PSI.

remaining_limits: Single bounded functional comparison, not a performance benchmark or exhaustive race proof.
Refault workloads evict slightly different hot page counts between runs; no throughput comparison is claimed.
This file-backed test does not validate swap-shadow restoration or anonymous swapped-page classification.
